Ten4SevenProvider.purpose: Resolve the semantic theme axes at an application root, including independent color sources and neutral canvas modes.

Typography.purpose: Render a semantic typography role with the active Inter Variable and optical sizing contract.

T7Icon.purpose: Render a semantic icon from the local Solar registry or the complete bundled Iconify catalog without exposing provider identifiers to product code.

Button.purpose: Trigger an explicit application action with intent, loading, and disabled semantics.

IconButton.purpose: Render an accessible compact action with a required text label.

ButtonGroup.purpose: Visually bind closely related peer actions without inventing new button variants.

ToggleButton.purpose: Expose a pressed state for a compact reversible view or option control.

ToggleButtonGroup.purpose: Coordinate single or multiple ToggleButton values.

SplitButton.purpose: Pair one primary action with a canonical overflow menu.

Input.purpose: Collect a labelled short text value with helper and invalid state support.

SearchInput.purpose: Apply the canonical search input type and semantic search icon.

PasswordInput.purpose: Collect a password with a local visibility toggle and native input semantics.

NumberInput.purpose: Collect a native decimal or integer value.

CurrencyInput.purpose: Collect a numeric monetary value without owning localization or ledger business logic.

PercentInput.purpose: Collect a numeric percentage with clear helper wording.

Select.purpose: Choose one value from a known bounded set through a custom ten4seven popup; use NativeSelect when platform-native behavior is intentional.

NativeSelect.purpose: Render an explicitly native select when platform-native behavior or form integration is the requirement.

Combobox.purpose: Search and choose one option from a bounded in-memory list.

MultiSelect.purpose: Choose multiple options from a bounded visible list.

Checkbox.purpose: Choose a boolean or one item from a multi-choice list with indeterminate support.

CheckboxGroup.purpose: Provide fieldset and legend semantics for related checkboxes.

Radio.purpose: Choose one value from a small mutually exclusive set.

RadioGroup.purpose: Provide fieldset and legend semantics for related radio controls.

Switch.purpose: Toggle one immediate boolean preference with a compact binary control.

Slider.purpose: Set one bounded numeric value using a native range input.

RangeSlider.purpose: Set a minimum and maximum value with two coordinated native ranges.

OtpInput.purpose: Collect a short verification code with keyboard and paste distribution support.

Field.purpose: Provide reusable labelled field anatomy around compound or custom controls.

Label.purpose: Render an explicit field label with required or optional indication.

FieldGroup.purpose: Group related controls with fieldset, legend, description, and error semantics.

FormSection.purpose: Group related fields into a neutral form section with an optional action.

FormGrid.purpose: Lay out related form fields with token-led responsive columns.

FormActions.purpose: Lay out local form actions before a broader ActionFooter is warranted.

Calendar.purpose: Render a keyboard-addressable month grid using stable YYYY-MM-DD values.

DatePicker.purpose: Collect one calendar date with native text entry and a shared calendar popover.

DateRangePicker.purpose: Collect a stable start and end date with one range-aware calendar.

TimeInput.purpose: Compatibility alias for the intentional browser-native time input.

NativeTimeInput.purpose: Collect a browser-native time value when platform-specific time input is intentional.

TimePicker.purpose: Choose a bounded time from a tokenized ten4seven listbox interaction.

DateTimeInput.purpose: Compose a DatePicker and TimePicker without owning time zone or persistence logic.

FileUpload.purpose: Select and validate files client-side without implying storage or upload transport.

FileItem.purpose: Show one selected, uploading, ready, or errored file state.

FileList.purpose: Render a list of FileItem contracts.

AppShell.purpose: Provide the shared app frame for an optional sidebar, topbar, and route content.

Sidebar.purpose: Render a responsive semantic workspace navigation with grouped routes and active state.

SidebarGroup.purpose: Group related sidebar items under an optional semantic label.

NavItem.purpose: Render one semantic navigation button with an icon and active state.

NavigationMenu.purpose: Render compact public navigation with one-level nested branches and shared floating positioning.

TopNavigation.purpose: Render horizontal navigation or a safe-area-aware bottom bar with reserved content space.

MobileSidebar.purpose: Compose compact-screen navigation inside the canonical left Drawer.

Breadcrumb.purpose: Show the route ancestry with current-page semantics.

Tabs.purpose: Switch between peer content panels with tab and tabpanel semantics.

Accordion.purpose: Progressively disclose bounded sections with explicit expansion state.

Collapsible.purpose: Show or hide one bounded content region with button and region semantics.

Stepper.purpose: Show a bounded sequential workflow and current step.

MilestoneTracker.purpose: Show a bounded operational workflow with selectable stages, integrated progress, and contextual detail.

CommandMenu.purpose: Search and execute a bounded local set of keyboard-first commands.

Pagination.purpose: Move through a bounded set of results with clear result range feedback.

Card.purpose: Contain one visual record or concise grouped summary with bounded semantic surface emphasis.

CardHeader.purpose: Provide the heading region of a Card.

CardContent.purpose: Provide the content region of a Card.

CardFooter.purpose: Provide a separated lower action or metadata region for a Card.

Surface.purpose: Provide a broad semantic page-region surface.

Panel.purpose: Provide a bounded supporting region such as a settings or inspector panel.

Section.purpose: Frame a route section with optional title, description, and actions.

Separator.purpose: Render a semantic horizontal or vertical divider.

ScrollArea.purpose: Constrain a scrollable region while preserving native browser scroll behavior.

PageHeader.purpose: Frame a route with title, context, breadcrumbs, metadata, and primary actions.

SectionHeader.purpose: Render an in-flow section heading with optional eyebrow, description, and actions.

Toolbar.purpose: Align a small primary control region with secondary actions.

ActionBar.purpose: Group compact surface actions with toolbar semantics.

Table.purpose: Render a lightweight semantic table for readable summaries and comparison data.

TableHeader.purpose: Provide the native table header section for a lightweight semantic Table.

TableBody.purpose: Provide the native table body section for lightweight semantic rows.

TableRow.purpose: Keep one semantic table record or header row together.

TableHead.purpose: Label a semantic table column or row header with explicit scope.

TableCell.purpose: Render one semantic data cell in a lightweight Table.

DataTable.purpose: Display comparable structured records with native table, sort, selection, state, density, visibility, and sticky column support.

DataTableColumnPicker.purpose: Control the visibility map for optional DataTable columns.

Badge.purpose: Show a compact semantic category or state label.

StatusChip.purpose: Make compact state semantics explicit with an optional state icon.

Avatar.purpose: Show an image or deterministic initials fallback for a person or entity.

AvatarGroup.purpose: Show a bounded overlapping group of Avatar contracts.

KeyValueList.purpose: Render labels and values as a semantic description list.

MetricCard.purpose: Show one truthful decision signal with structured comparison, progress, chart, action, and footer slots.

KPICluster.purpose: Present a small related set of truthful metrics with consistent value, trend, progress, chart, action, and footer anatomy.

ActivityFeed.purpose: Render an ordered activity or audit event feed.

RecordSummary.purpose: Make the key context of one record scannable before its details.

ProductCard.purpose: Present one visual product with media, metadata, price, and bounded actions.

ProductGrid.purpose: Lay out visual products in a responsive content-first grid.

Price.purpose: Render a localized display price and optional previous price.

Rating.purpose: Render a compact read-only rating signal and optional count.

ProductMeta.purpose: Lay out compact product metadata without publishing-specific nouns.

FilterToolbar.purpose: Keep search, filters, sort, and result actions in one labelled region.

FilterChip.purpose: Show one removable applied filter value.

AppliedFilters.purpose: Render the current active filters with remove and reset actions.

FilterDrawer.purpose: Compose mobile or compact filter controls in the canonical Drawer.

BulkActionBar.purpose: Expose safe operations for selected records.

Modal.purpose: Present focused short content or confirmation through a native modal dialog.

Drawer.purpose: Present contextual content in a reusable modal side surface while retaining the parent route context.

DetailDrawer.purpose: Inspect a selected record in a responsive contextual drawer.

AlertDialog.purpose: Confirm a consequential action before it is performed.

Popover.purpose: Show dismissible non-modal anchored supporting content.

Tooltip.purpose: Show supplemental hover and focus information.

DropdownMenu.purpose: Expose a bounded semantic action menu from a trigger.

ActionMenu.purpose: Name a DropdownMenu used specifically for secondary record actions.

ContextMenu.purpose: Expose a bounded semantic action menu on a secondary context interaction.

Alert.purpose: Show persistent in-context feedback as a semantic callout with bounded emphasis.

ToastProvider.purpose: Own local transient notification state and a Toaster viewport.

Toaster.purpose: Render transient toast notifications from ToastProvider or controlled data.

Toast.purpose: Render one transient live notification with optional action and dismissal.

EmptyState.purpose: Explain an empty result with optional recovery action.

StateView.purpose: Render empty, error, permission, or unavailable state with an optional recovery action.

Skeleton.purpose: Represent layout-shaped loading content without pretending data is ready.

Spinner.purpose: Announce an indeterminate short loading operation.

Progress.purpose: Show determinate or indeterminate linear progress with progressbar semantics.

CircularProgress.purpose: Show compact determinate progress in a circular signal.

TrendIndicator.purpose: Show compact directional change while keeping movement separate from business sentiment.

Sparkline.purpose: Render a compact inline SVG trend signal.

LineChart.purpose: Render one or more ordered SVG data series with labels, legend, and token chart palette.

BarChart.purpose: Render comparable categorical magnitudes as a token-colored SVG bar chart.

DonutChart.purpose: Render a small whole-to-part distribution with token-based segments and legend.

AspectRatio.purpose: Preserve an explicit media ratio without page-local positioning hacks.

MediaFrame.purpose: Contain visual media in a semantic ratio and surface frame.

Image.purpose: Render native imagery with an honest local fallback when a source fails.

ApprovalPanel.purpose: Frame a neutral decision checkpoint with context, metadata, and actions.

ActionFooter.purpose: Create a clear primary and secondary action boundary at the end of a task.

CardTitle.purpose: Render the semantic heading inside a Card anatomy.

CardDescription.purpose: Render supporting copy inside a Card header without creating a local muted-text style.

FieldDescription.purpose: Attach concise helper text to a field using the shared semantic description treatment.

FieldError.purpose: Announce an actionable field validation error with the shared error treatment.

TabPanel.purpose: Provide a semantic tabpanel for custom Tab compositions.

CommandPalette.purpose: Expose CommandMenu under the familiar command-palette alias; it is not a second implementation.

DescriptionList.purpose: Expose KeyValueList under the conventional description-list alias; it remains one implementation.

Timeline.purpose: Expose ActivityFeed under the conventional timeline alias; it remains one ordered-event implementation.

ChartLegend.purpose: Render the shared labeled key for a token-colored SVG chart.

QuantityControl.purpose: Adjust a bounded numeric quantity with a compact, accessible control.

CartTrigger.purpose: Expose a shared cart entry action while leaving cart state and navigation to the recipe.

CartLineItem.purpose: Present one cart item with content, price, bounded quantity, and an optional remove action.

CartPanel.purpose: Compose cart lines, empty state, summary, and actions into one shared commerce surface.

OrderSummary.purpose: Present application-calculated order rows and a total without owning payment logic.

Carousel.purpose: Present an ordered set of related content in a bounded native-scroll rail with keyboard and indicator controls.

PublicShell.purpose: Compose the shared app frame and top navigation for public, content, and marketing references.

ChartPanel.purpose: Bound a canonical chart with a readable heading, description, and token-driven surface.
